forecasts.question: What cash rate target, in percent, will the Reserve Bank of Australia announce on 3 November 2026?

target.definition: The cash rate target in percent stated in the official RBA Monetary Policy Decision media release for 3 November 2026.

horizon.description: From the 26 September 2026 UTC information cutoff to the scheduled RBA decision publication.

resolution.resolution_rule: Use the numeric cash rate target in the first official RBA media release for the 3 November 2026 Monetary Policy Decision; do not use later commentary or infer a target from market pricing.
resolution.resolution_source_basis: The RBA Monetary Policy Board calendar and decision publication are the pre-declared authoritative source; no fallback with equivalent authority is permitted.
resolution.vintage_definition: The first official RBA release that states the 3 November 2026 cash rate target.
resolution.measurement_time_basis: The target announced for the decision date, not a later effective-date revision.

assumptions.statement: The RBA publishes a decision release that states a single cash rate target in percent.
assumptions.rationale: The target and source are defined by the official decision-release contract.
assumptions.provenance: Pilot analyst review; no upstream production analytical object was manufactured.

forecasts.rationale: Transparent baseline estimate equal to the latest official cash rate target reported in the RBA's 11 August 2026 decision. The official RBA schedule confirms the 2–3 November meeting and 3 November decision publication. No market consensus is copied into this estimate.

review_provenance.decision_basis: Owner-authorised prospective pilot admission; target remains unresolved, source and first-release vintage are explicit, and no political or conflict forecast is involved.

forecasts.revision_reason: Initial prospective pilot issuance; substantive content is frozen after admission.

forecasts.question: What Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate, in percent, will be announced on 28 October 2026?

target.definition: The target for the overnight rate in the Bank of Canada's first official 28 October 2026 interest-rate announcement.

horizon.description: From the 26 September 2026 UTC information cutoff to the scheduled Bank of Canada announcement.

resolution.resolution_rule: Use the target for the overnight rate in the first official Bank of Canada interest-rate announcement dated 28 October 2026; do not use later revisions or market-implied rates.
resolution.resolution_source_basis: The Bank of Canada's fixed announcement schedule and policy-interest-rate page are the pre-declared authoritative source; no fallback with equivalent authority is permitted.
resolution.vintage_definition: The first official Bank of Canada release that states the 28 October 2026 target.
resolution.measurement_time_basis: The announced target on the scheduled decision date.

assumptions.statement: The Bank of Canada publishes a single target for the overnight rate in its scheduled announcement.
assumptions.rationale: The official policy-rate page defines the target and fixed announcement schedule.
assumptions.provenance: Pilot analyst review; no upstream production analytical object was manufactured.

forecasts.rationale: Transparent persistence baseline equal to the latest official target shown by the Bank of Canada as at the cutoff. The official schedule identifies 28 October 2026 as an interest-rate announcement and Monetary Policy Report date. No external consensus is treated as independent WORLD SIGNALS evidence.

review_provenance.decision_basis: Owner-authorised prospective pilot admission; target remains unresolved, source and first-release vintage are explicit, and no political or conflict forecast is involved.

forecasts.revision_reason: Initial prospective pilot issuance; substantive content is frozen after admission.

forecasts.question: What direction will the ECB's three key policy rates move at the 29 October 2026 monetary-policy decision relative to their 10 September 2026 levels?

target.definition: Joint direction of the deposit facility, main refinancing operations and marginal lending facility rates in the first official ECB decision release for 29 October 2026.

outcomes.label: Increase
outcomes.definition: All three key ECB rates are higher than their 10 September 2026 levels.

outcomes.label: Unchanged
outcomes.definition: All three key ECB rates are unchanged from their 10 September 2026 levels.

outcomes.label: Decrease
outcomes.definition: All three key ECB rates are lower than their 10 September 2026 levels.

outcomes.label: Mixed direction
outcomes.definition: The three key ECB rates do not all move in the same direction.

forecast_value.coverage_basis: The categories partition the joint direction of all three named official rates; a missing or cancelled decision follows the pre-declared void/unresolvable policy rather than inventing a category.

horizon.description: From the 26 September 2026 UTC information cutoff to the scheduled ECB decision release.

resolution.resolution_rule: Compare the three named key ECB rates in the first official 29 October 2026 decision release with the 10 September 2026 official levels; resolve the matching joint-direction category, or mark unresolvable if the release is unavailable or cancelled.
resolution.resolution_source_basis: The ECB Governing Council calendar and monetary-policy decision publication are the pre-declared authoritative source; no fallback with equivalent authority is permitted.
resolution.vintage_definition: Not applicable to a categorical policy-direction decision.
resolution.measurement_time_basis: The three policy rates stated in the official decision release.

assumptions.statement: The ECB decision release reports the three named policy rates in a comparable form.
assumptions.rationale: The ECB publishes all three key rates together in its monetary-policy decision releases.
assumptions.provenance: Pilot analyst review; no upstream production analytical object was manufactured.

forecasts.rationale: Categorical estimate uses an explicit persistence baseline after the 10 September 2026 official 25-basis-point increase, while retaining non-zero mass for further increase, decrease and mixed movement. The official ECB calendar confirms the 29 October monetary-policy meeting and decision publication.

review_provenance.decision_basis: Owner-authorised prospective pilot admission; target remains unresolved, category definitions are exhaustive, and no political or conflict forecast is involved.

forecasts.revision_reason: Initial prospective pilot issuance; substantive content is frozen after admission.

forecasts.question: What direction will the Federal Reserve's federal funds target range move at the 28 October 2026 FOMC decision relative to the 16 September 2026 range?

target.definition: Direction of the official federal funds target range in the first FOMC statement for the 28 October 2026 decision relative to the 16 September 2026 range.

outcomes.label: Increase
outcomes.definition: The official target range is higher than the 16 September 2026 range.

outcomes.label: Unchanged
outcomes.definition: The official target range is unchanged from the 16 September 2026 range.

outcomes.label: Decrease
outcomes.definition: The official target range is lower than the 16 September 2026 range.

forecast_value.coverage_basis: The categories partition the direction of the single official federal funds target range; a cancelled or unavailable decision follows the pre-declared void/unresolvable policy.

horizon.description: From the 26 September 2026 UTC information cutoff to the scheduled FOMC decision statement.

resolution.resolution_rule: Compare the federal funds target range in the first official FOMC statement for 28 October 2026 with the 16 September 2026 official range and resolve increase, unchanged or decrease; do not infer a result from market pricing.
resolution.resolution_source_basis: The Federal Reserve FOMC calendar and official FOMC statement are the pre-declared authoritative source; no fallback with equivalent authority is permitted.
resolution.vintage_definition: Not applicable to a categorical policy-direction decision.
resolution.measurement_time_basis: The target range stated in the official FOMC statement.

assumptions.statement: The FOMC publishes one official target range in its decision statement.
assumptions.rationale: The FOMC statement is the pre-declared primary resolution record.
assumptions.provenance: Pilot analyst review; no upstream production analytical object was manufactured.

forecasts.rationale: Categorical estimate uses an explicit persistence baseline after the 16 September 2026 official increase, retaining non-zero mass for another increase or a decrease. The official Federal Reserve calendar confirms the 27–28 October meeting and the official FOMC statement is the resolution record.

review_provenance.decision_basis: Owner-authorised prospective pilot admission; target remains unresolved, category definitions are exhaustive, and no political or conflict forecast is involved.

forecasts.revision_reason: Initial prospective pilot issuance; substantive content is frozen after admission.
